_comment: Portfolio memory seed — what gets written into the AgentCore Memory CUSTOM strategy namespace. SPEC G-21, §22.4, and every one of its four rules is structural here rather than a hope. (1) NO PRECEDENT LAUNDERING: every row is built only from ATTESTED answers; `attested_count` is the whole population, and drafts, pre-fills and unconfirmed values are invisible to it. (2) AGGREGATE, NEVER DISCLOSE: rows carry counts only — no project name, no owner, no other team's content — and a row below `minimum_comparable_count` is dropped entirely, because a precedent drawn from one assessment is gossip, not evidence, and it also leaks who. (3) NO ANCHORING: `never_preselect` is true and the phrasing is 'how others answered', never a recommendation to argue with. (4) AGE IS PART OF THE FACT: every row carries how many and how recently.

rules.divergence_note: A divergence is a triage signal for the reviewer, never pressure on the requester toward the majority. Being different is often correct.
